$comment: Machine-readable Syrmos iOS/Android/Web parity ledger. Derived from docs/plans/2026-09-01-android-ios-parity-audit.md. status: matched | fixed | partial | backlog | intentional | blocked-external. Update when a row's parity changes.
reference: iOS is the product reference; Android/Web are brought to a deliberate-difference 1:1.

backlog.9: genuine product decision (iOS local-first Athens vs server-first); no correctness gap
backlog.10: external + tied to #9; router built + DI-registered but no consumer, live path depends on the Pi endpoint
backlog.11: server tier unanimous (SCHEDULED); only the offline label is a design call

intentional.21: CADisplayLink vs per-tick motion; user-visible behaviour equivalent

deepQaSummary.note: No engineering P0/P1 open. The 3 backlog items are product/external decisions, not defects; #13 is polish gated on a small seed-data addition; #21 is an engine-only difference. #12 is fixed server-side and deploy-gated on the Pi.
deepQaSummary.adversarialPass: A post-change adversarial review of #12/#14/#7 caught two real defects that compiled and passed happy-path tests: a HIGH silent no-op in the #12 server override (wrong column name, masked by a test fixture that did not match the production schema; fixed in #83) and a MEDIUM latent persistence-corruption in the /api/lines overlay membership positions (fixed in #84). Both are fixed with regression tests. The #7 observer and #14 removal were reviewed clean.
deepQaSummary.dataNoteForPi: The client's line3AirportOnlyStations {M3_PAL, M3_PEA, M3_KO2, M3_AER} matches the bundled seed; the server projector uses {M3_PAL, M3_PEK, M3_KRP, M3_AER}, whose M3_PEK/M3_KRP ids are not in the seed. Each side is internally consistent, but the Pi vs seed station-id spelling for Peania-Kantza / Koropi should be reconciled so a client station_id always resolves on the server. Verify against the live Pi DB (not reachable from CI).

Proximity (150m) interchange with actionable per-line transfer targets
Greek holiday calendar applied on the offline seed day-type path
Search matches name/nameEl/nameSq/id

Denied/empty location shows an enable-location CTA
features.note: NearbyLocationCta in the empty branch; verified on emulator

features.expected: Pull-to-refresh + event-driven reconnect retry
features.note: pull-to-refresh + retry signal (#60); ConnectivityObserver now calls LiveDataFreshness.requestRetry() on network onAvailable, mirroring the iOS NWPathMonitor. Verified on emulator: the callback fires on an airplane-off reconnect and drives the home probe, no crash.

features.expected: Metro/tram line detail shows live trains + upcoming departures, localized
features.note: title/count localized (#59); upcoming-departures fallback for every line (#74), verified on emulator

features.expected: One source-selection policy (local-first for Athens)
features.note: Genuine product decision, re-examined in the deep QA. iOS is LOCAL-first for Athens (StationDetailView never calls the network there); Android and Web are SERVER-first for every region. iOS (the reference) and Web do NOT agree, so there is no majority-derived canonical answer; the leading candidate (local-first for Athens, per the reference) needs an explicit product call, not a code guess. No user-facing correctness gap today: all three return the same trains, only the source ordering differs.

features.expected: LIVE->SCHEDULED fallback wired as first tier (X93-97 live ETAs)
features.note: External blocker + tied to #9. LiveArrivalsRouter and its providers are built AND Koin-registered (DomainModule), but nothing resolves the router (no consumer), and GetNextDeparturesUseCase does not take it. OASA endpoint is configured (api-syrmos.peterdsp.dev/api/oasa-airport-buses); the two other providers are intentional null placeholders (no operator feed exists). Wiring it is a source-policy change (#9) whose only live path depends on the Pi endpoint actually serving X93-97 data (unverifiable from CI). Deliberately not wired for GA.

features.expected: One confidence rule shared by all clients
features.note: Mostly settled by existing behavior: all three stamp SCHEDULED for server rows (unanimous). They diverge only on the offline/projected tier (iOS still scheduled, Web offline, Android ESTIMATED for bands / OFFLINE for seed). The shared enum lives in core:model and Android already has a working per-tier rule in GetNextDeparturesUseCase; only that one label needs a design choice. Copying the iOS reference literally would throw away Android's richer signal, so left as a deliberate design call, not a bug.

features.expected: Short-turn last-train destination override in the shared projector
features.note: Fixed server-side. project_next_departures now applies the last_train_endpoints short-turn override (M1 00:30 -> Omonia, not Kifissia). Android and Web are server-first so they inherit it with no client change; iOS was already correct via its synced bundle. NOTE: the adversarial pass caught that the initial fix (#80) queried a nonexistent stations.name column (production has name_en/name_el), so the OperationalError guard swallowed it and the override was a silent no-op in production; #83 corrects it to name_en and rebuilds the test fixture to mirror the production schema so a wrong column now fails the tests. Offline (bundled seed ships zero short-turn rows) every platform shows the line terminal, consistent. Deploy note: takes effect once the Pi applies migration 0017 and the STASY scraper populates the table; a verified no-op until then. The KMP/Web client fallback band-projectors do NOT mirror the override yet (a documented fast-follow, no-op offline since the seed is empty).

features.expected: Canonical copy per key across platforms
features.note: subtitle + news header aligned (#56). #86 localizes the Airport route-strip station names (M3/A1/X95/X97), which were hardcoded English. NOTE: an earlier deep-QA note called this a seed-DATA gap (nameEl=null for M3_DIM/M3_DOY); that was a false alarm from checking the camelCase field - the seed uses name_el and every station has complete name_el/name_sq, so #86 pulls the exact seed values through airportText(). Verified on the emulator in Greek. Other Airport-tab hardcodes remain SHARED with iOS (not a divergence).

features.expected: Recents store, refresh feedback, digest toggle wired or hidden
features.note: The Android morning-digest toggle only persisted notif_morning_digest with no consumer (dead UI); hidden for GA (satisfies the 'wired or hidden' criterion), verified on emulator. Refresh feedback already present on Android (Last updated + Check now). Recents store is an iOS-only feature (absent on Android/Web) tracked as a separate post-2.0 feature, not dead UI.

features.expected: Fast per-call timeouts on live/departures
Canonical /api/lines behaviour (overlay vs upsert)
features.note: LinesRefresher overlay-only (matches iOS); strictly write-reducing. #84 (adversarial-pass finding) fixes a latent persistence bug: a novel stop attaching to a seeded line used its payload index as position_on_line, which collided with a seeded stop on a mid-line insert and made ORDER BY nondeterministic; membershipPosition now parks overlay-added stops past every seeded position (collision-free, deterministic).

features.expected: Accent/tonos-insensitive search
features.note: shared normalizer; iOS can adopt it

features.expected: Compound departure label + heading + alert live-region
features.note: DepartureCard merged into one TalkBack node + section headings; verified via a11y node tree

features.expected: News keeps last good payload offline
Athens time via the IANA tz everywhere
Aligned map padding / vehicle motion
features.note: Implementation-only difference, user behaviour equivalent. Vehicle motion is driven by CADisplayLink on iOS (native, display-synced) and a per-tick coroutine on Compose/Android; both interpolate the same projected positions along the same shapes at the same wall-clock, so a rider sees the same train in the same place. Matching engines is neither possible (no CADisplayLink on Android) nor better. Not a parity gap under the user-visible-behaviour rule. (A minor map-padding tweak remains cosmetic backlog.)

features.expected: One GPS-less train does not blank the live map
Circular bus routes draw their return leg
One malformed announcement does not void the feed
One malformed live/offset row does not drop the whole layer
Airport service tiles/rows/legs open the stop's Station Detail
